tasks.label: Remove CSS comments
args:
import re, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(r'c:\Users\aymou\Documents\Bachelor 3\Projet final\baseball_v1\assets\styles')
for path in root.glob('*.css'):
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    new=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/','',text,flags=re.S)
    if new!=text:
        path.write_text(new,encoding='utf-8')
        print(f'updated {path.name}')
